## Proposal — issue-244-a4 (Track A / Slice A4 — GitLab substrate ladder awareness)

**File:** openspec/changes/issue-244-a4/proposal.md (primary artifact; openspec store).

**Intent/problem:** substrate ladder is GitHub-wired + reports rung-1 dishonestly on GitLab. (1) `realBranchProtectionProbe` (brain-governance-status.mjs:45-63) hardcoded to `gh api` → GitLab rung-1 undetectable though gitlab.mjs already has the endpoint (capabilities() :322-342, branchProtect() :254-306). (2) `evalRung1` (substrate.mjs:97-141) short-circuits at :98-100 on `config.vcs.selfHostedPreReceive===true` UNCONDITIONALLY — a config flag trusted as verified, though no endpoint can detect a server-side hook.

**Reframe:** pre-receive hook already runs commit-format+ticket-ref as self-contained sh+git+grep (zero-Node contract). diff-size EXCLUDED. So A4 adds NO new hook binary; "extend not sibling" = augment substrate.mjs / brain-governance-status.mjs / existing test harness.

**3 deliverables:**
- D1 (substrate.mjs): rung-1 as parallel sub-gates rungs[1].gates.{protectedBranches (verifiable:true), preReceive (verifiable:false, mechanism:'pre-receive-config-declared')}, mirroring brainWritesReviewed sub-gate (:149-203). active = protectedBranches.active || preReceive.active. Replace selfHostedPreReceive short-circuit.
- D2 (brain-governance-status.mjs): provider-branch realBranchProtectionProbe (mirror realBrainWritesReviewedProbe :78-111), reuse glab api protected_branches; print "not remotely detectable; verify via install runbook" when armed by preReceive.
- D3 (CP-A4a): bare-repo rejection fixture reusing pre-receive.test.mjs setupFixture/commitAndPush; + governance-status offline fixtures (verified vs declared).
Docs: EXTEND (not duplicate) docs/inbox/self-hosted-pre-receive.md.

**Locked design decision:** Approach C (parallel sub-gates) + Approach B (verifiability field) COMBINED. Rejected B-alone (single verifiable bool) because GitLab has 2 independent rung-1 mechanisms; collapsing keeps illegibility. SIGNAL (verifiable/mechanism) in substrate (data); CAVEAT TEXT in governance-status (presentation) — change together. selectRung() (:207-212) untouched; OR-composition localized to evalRung1 return.

**Honesty principle (constraint 3):** remote-undetectability reported as such, never verified. Lesson [[workflow/env-limits-not-world-properties]].

**Non-goals:** diff-size in hook (constraint 2, MR-level semantics false-reject); GitLab-CI job registry (REQUIRED_JOBS equiv — OUT, A4 is awareness not orchestration); real GitLab server hook install (SCIT, needs Gitaly custom_hooks/ host-fs admin); CP-A3b/CP-A2b live smoke (SCIT).

**Acceptance split:** CP-A4a (this slice, offline/fixture) = bare-repo rejection fixture-tested + honest governance-status + npm test/brain:audit/brain:repo:check/brain:nav green. Track A closing (post-SCIT) = real-MR block on self-hosted GitLab.

**Budget:** <=400 lines, no size:exception, strict TDD, English (ADR-0009).

**Relates-to:** ADR-0014/0015, ADR-0009, PLAN §2 A4, issue #244, siblings A2 #231 / A3 #239.

**Open questions for owner (before spec/design):** (Q2) GitLab protected-branch verification DEPTH — is presence alone the rung-1 signal, or fold in only_allow_merge_if_pipeline_succeeds as the contexts-equivalent? (Q) confirm GitLab-CI job registry is a genuine non-goal. (Q3) per-branch read vs reuse capabilities() collection read.
